A '''base''' of the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] was located on the celestial body [[Gestrex III]]. The base was equipped with weapons storage and repair facilities. It was decimated by a team of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Commando/Legends|commandos]].<ref name="GG10">''[[Galaxy Guide 10: Bounty Hunters]]''</ref>
